SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.CREATEDBYNAME AS PROJUSERNAME, B.PROJNO, B.PROJNAME, B.ORGID, B.ORGNAME, B.TESTORGNAME, B.ENTRUSTORGNAME, B.CREATEDBYNAME AS PROJCREATEDBYNAME, B.REPORTREVIEWERID, B.REPORTREVIEWERNAME, B.REPORTISSUEUSERID, B.REPORTISSUEUSERNAME, B.REPORTEDITUSERNAME, B.REPORTEDITUSERID, C.ID AS BIZID, C.BIZCATEGORYID, C.BIZCATEGORYNAME, C.FLOWCONTROL, D.REPORTNAME, F.MONITORTMPLGROUP, G.REPORTNAME AS RSREPORTNAME FROM T_EMC_REPORT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT B ON A.PROJID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_BIZ_CATEGORY C ON B.BIZCATEGORYID=C.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_REPORT_CONFIG_LINE D ON A.REPORTCONFIGLINEID = D.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL E ON A.MONITORTMPLID = E.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_TMPL_GROUP F ON E.MONITORTMPLGROUPID = F.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_REPORT_CONFIG_LINE G ON A.RSREPORTCONFIGLINEID = G.ID) T
AND (T.REPORTEDITUSERID = #{currentUserId} OR T.REPORTEDITUSERID IS NULL )
AND
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_PROJECT TAR_ WHERE TAR_.ID = T.PROJID AND TAR_.REPORTREVIEWERID = #{currentUserId} )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_PROJECT TAR_ WHERE TAR_.ID = T.PROJID AND TAR_.REPORTISSUEUSERID = #{currentUserId} )
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
SELECT A.* FROM T_EMC_REPORT A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJECT B ON A.PROJID = B.ID WHERE A.PROCESSSTATUS = 'draft' AND B.COMPLEDATE <= SYSDATE
